messages:
Raj: Heads up — noticed a regression in EU1 after last night's rollout (v2026.03.10). p50 stable but p99 and 5xxs spiked. Customers reporting slow gen times. Proposing a hotfix: v2026.03.11 -> canary then expedited rollout. Need approvals to shorten canary window.

DeployBot: New deploy job created: hotfix/eu1 v2026.03.11. Canary policy: 3% for 60m by default. Required approvers: infra lead, oncall, product. To rollback use: `./deploy rollback --env eu1 --to v2026.03.10`

Marta: I can approve infra side but please pin model artifact hash and include quantization profile. Also add explicit rollback criteria. :+1:

SRE-OnCall: Rollback triggers we want: >0.5% 5xx sustained over 5m OR p99 latency increase > 1s vs baseline for 5m. If either met, auto-rollback to previous stable. Also enable metric alerting to #incidents.

QA-Team: Running smoke now against canary nodes. Quick log snippet showing OOM-ish pattern:
```
2026-03-11T09:12:04Z eu1-node-3 gen_worker: memory growth observed: rss +200MB/min
stack: /redwood/runtime/kv_cache.cpp:line 214
```

Linh: Could be KV cache corner case with sequence lengths > 8k. Suggest fallback route to q4-compat model variant while we push patch. We can route via header `X-Model-Variant: fallback-q4` for affected customers.

Evan: Product approves expedited path; impact on SLA and customer comms understood. I can sign off. :thumbsup:

Raj: Requesting approval to shorten canary to 10m (from 60m) and start at 09:15 UTC — customer incidents rising. I'll monitor and be ready to trigger rollback.

Marta: Approve to shorten to 10m, conditional on auto-rollback config and pinned artifact hash.

SRE-OnCall: Approve, setting auto-rollback with the criteria above. Will watch metrics and take manual rollback if anything weird.

DeployBot: Approvals recorded: Marta, Evan, SRE-OnCall. Canary will start now per expedited window. Deploy started at 1898765460.

DeployBot: Canary reached target 3% at 1898765475. Health checks: 200/200 healthy.

QA-Team: Smoke passed against canary at 1898765480. No OOMs in the 10m window.

Linh: Rolling temporary route for high-risk tenants to `fallback-q4` for 30m using: `kubectl label ns tenant-123 route=fallback-q4 --overwrite`

Raj: Thanks all — rolling to 100% in 8m if metrics remain green. Will update #incidents and ops.

DeployBot: Canary complete. No rollback triggered. Final rollout scheduled and executing to 100% at 1898765510.

Raj: Done — rollout to 100% finished at 1898765520. Monitoring for 30m. Will post postmortem if anything unexpected crops up. :white_check_mark:
